note: Item codes ARE the source CSV column names (Emotion_Controlled ... Emotion_Protected in dataset_linear_model.csv); data/di_riso_2025_mask_emotion.py melts them unchanged, so there is no rename or positional step. The codes are self-describing and the paper's Table 2 lists the same eight adjectives, so the tie is a label match. Mapping additionally checked against Table 2's per-item M/SD (Step 5b route 1, all eight matched to <=0.005). English is the authors' own rendering in an English-language paper; the administered Italian wording is not published anywhere in the deposit or supplements, hence translated_substitute rather than a base/_translated pair. No NC, redistribution or fee restriction: the instrument is the authors' own ad hoc interview, published CC BY 4.0.
public_note: The instrument is an ad hoc block administered in Italian, and no Italian wording was published; the shipped item text is the English one-word emotion label the paper's Table 2 uses (Controlled, Weak, Scared, Silly, Brave, Caring, Strong, Protected), not a full administered item stem, and scale points 2-4 are unlabelled in the source
